what: A screen-height section is made sticky with 600px of space below, and while scrolling through that space the next section covers it from below (stacking). The video · photo inside the pinned section (130% height) drifts up by 30% of the section height without a Curve while scrolling half the section height, and the covering section stays live too — a Work list that flips one video at a time full screen

options.drift: Amount the inside flows upward (multiple of section height), default .3
options.span: Scroll distance while flowing (section height multiplier), default .5
options.--fx-gap: Section bottom margin = Scroll it takes for the next section to cover (css), default 600px — the original text section is 300px
